about_item: ORTHOPEDIC SUPPORT DOG BED：This orthopedic dog bed is made with thick, high-density egg-crate foam that evenly distributes weight and helps relieve pressure on joints and muscles. Ideal for large dogs, senior dogs, and pets with arthritis, it provides reliable daily support and promotes deeper, more comfortable sleep

SAFE & COMFORTABLE WITH SIDE BOLSTERS：The three-sided cushion design provides secure and comfortable support for your dog’s head and neck. Soft, generously filled bolsters allow pets to settle into various cozy positions, creating a calm and relaxing sleeping environment

WATERPROOF LINER & WASHABLE COVER：This dog sofa features a waterproof inner liner that helps protect the foam from accidental stains, drool, and liquid spills. The soft outer cover is fully removable and machine washable for easy, hassle-free cleaning

PET-SAFE MATERIALS WITH NON-SLIP BASE：Made with soft flannel fabric, this comfortable dog bed provides soothing comfort and is suitable for year-round use. The non-skid bottom keeps the bed securely in place on hardwood, tile, or carpet floors

MULTI-SIZE DOG BED FOR HOME & CRATE USE：Available in Medium (28" x 23"), Large (36" x 27"), and Extra Large (44" x 32") to fit dogs of all sizes. This dog sofa bed is suitable for all dog breeds, from small to extra-large, and also works well for cats of all ages, from kittens to seniors

REBOUND INSTRUCTIONS: This dog bed is vacuum-packed for shipping. After opening the package, gently pat the cushions, lay the foam base flat, and allow up to 48 hours for the bed to fully expand and regain its optimal shape and fluffiness

authors_reviews.title: Easy to clean
authors_reviews.text: As my dog enters his golden years, I realized his old fiber filled beds just wasn’t cutting it anymore for his aching joints. I decided to upgrade him to this Orthopedic Dog Bed by Aodisman to give his joints the extra relief and cushioning they need. When it first arrived vacuum sealed, I was worried it might stay thin and flat but after letting it expand for a couple of days, the foam fluffed up into a good supportive base.The egg crate foam layer inside does a solid job of making sure he isn't sinking into one spot which helps him wake up feeling less stiff. Since he’s a larger dog, I can tell the foam makes a noticeable difference in how easy he gets up after a long nap. And he’s definitely more comfortable because he’s no longer tossing and turning for twenty minutes before finally settling down.The three sided bolster worked well for him. He really like to use the raised edges as a pillow and the surrounding cushions seem to give him a sense of security while also keeping his head and neck at a comfortable angle.Maintenance is straightforward because when the cover eventually gets dirty, I can simply unzip it and toss it into the washing machine. Also the fabric lining has a waterproof coating that serves as a barrier, protecting the orthopedic foam from the inevitable drool, accidental spills or stains that come with daily pet life.All in all, I recommend this orthopedic bed for owners of senior dogs who require extra joint support and a dedicated headrest. It’s a durable, well designed and easy to maintain sleep solution that provides adequate comfort and support.

The non slip bottom helps keep it in place, and the washable cover is a practical feature for everyday use.It has a cozy feel while still offering support, especially for dogs that like to lean against the sides. authors_reviews.title: Your fur babies will thank you!
authors_reviews.text: Great pet bed and my Lab says so too! It came perfectly packaged and double wrapped in thick plastic inside of a box. It was vacuum sealed and instantly began to take shape when I opened. That process didn’t take long, no more than 24 hours. There was a slight scent that was not overpowering at all but that comes with every vacuum sealed item I’ve ever bought and it did fade within about 30 minutes. This pet bed is very supportive with the sides along the perimeters and Orthopedic memory foam bottom. I appreciate that is fully washable, easy to take the cover on and off. The Gray color doesn’t appear to show dirt easily which is a plus. Its every well made and nice quality, no loose stitching and the zipper appears to be sewn in nicely. My big pups for some reason love to share it and the sides are very supportive for their necks and heads. I chose the large and there is plenty of room for my 9 month old lab and 4 year old bulldog to get comfortable! Definitely worth the price and I’m sure it would work out great for your fur babies as well!
authors_reviews.author: Jami
